description: Source code for a generic prompt manager class that integrates with LiteLLM's prompt management system, fetching prompts from an API endpoint, with methods for synchronous and asynchronous prompt fetching, parsing, variable substitution, and cache management.

classes.name: GenericPromptManager
classes.description: A class that manages prompts by fetching and parsing prompt templates from an external API, supporting both sync and async operations, with caching and variable substitution features.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the prompt manager with API base URL, optional API key, timeout, prompt ID, and additional query parameters.

methods.name: integration_name
methods.description: Returns the string 'generic_prompt' used in model naming.

methods.name: _get_headers
methods.description: Constructs HTTP headers for API requests, including authorization if API key is provided.

methods.name: _fetch_prompt_from_api
methods.description: Fetches prompt data synchronously from the API endpoint, raising exceptions on failure.

methods.name: async_fetch_prompt_from_api
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches prompt data from the API endpoint, raising exceptions on failure.

methods.name: _parse_api_response
methods.description: Parses API response into a PromptManagementClient structure.

methods.name: should_run_prompt_management
methods.description: Determines if prompt management should run based on prompt ID or parameters.

methods.name: _get_cache_key
methods.description: Generates a cache key string based on prompt ID, label, and version.

methods.name: _common_caching_logic
methods.description: Checks cache for existing prompt data and applies variables if needed.

methods.name: _compile_prompt_helper
methods.description: Fetches, parses, caches, and applies variables to compile a prompt template into a PromptManagementClient.

methods.name: async_compile_prompt_helper
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches, parses, caches, and applies variables to compile a prompt template.

methods.name: _apply_variables
methods.description: Performs string substitution in prompt message contents using provided variables.

methods.name: async_get_chat_completion_prompt
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a chat prompt with prompt management integration.

methods.name: get_chat_completion_prompt
methods.description: Retrieves a chat prompt with prompt management, supporting variable substitution and cache.
